tagline: Paste a link. Get the file.

presetHints.mp3: Audio only, MP3 with cover art

queueEmpty: Nothing here yet. Paste a YouTube link above, or use the browser extension.

errors.age: This video is age-restricted. In Settings, turn on "Use cookies from browser" with a signed-in browser.
errors.bot: YouTube asked to confirm you're not a bot. In Settings, turn on "Use cookies from browser", or try again later.
errors.members: This video is for channel members only.
errors.network: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
errors.engine: The download engine couldn't start. Try reinstalling it in Settings.
errors.invalid-url: That doesn't look like a link.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Updating the engine in Settings often fixes it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.engineHint: yt-dlp updates itself daily. If downloads start failing, update it manually.
settings.extensionHint: Adds a Download button right on YouTube.
settings.cookiesHint: Turn on if YouTube asks to sign in or confirm you're not a bot. Pick a browser where you're signed in to YouTube. Cookies stay on your computer.

firstRun.title: Setting things up
firstRun.text: Downloading the tools that do the heavy lifting. This happens once and takes about a minute.
firstRun.failed: Couldn't download the tools. Check your internet connection.
